Welcome to a Musical Journey with the Wahane Sisters at Darbar Festival 2022
Join us as we revisit a mesmerizing performance from the Darbar Festival 2022, where the talented Wahane sisters, Sanskrati and Prakrati, graced the stage with their inaugural international concert. Hailing from Ujjain, India, these young maestros have been nurtured in the rich traditions of the Etawah gharana, under the guidance of their father, Lokesh Wahane, and further honed their skills with the legendary Ustad Shahid Parvez and Pandit Suresh Talwalkar .
